description: Cell with TP53 +/- (heterozygous), genome is unstable, experiencing increased mutation rate

identity.role: Pre-neoplastic cell with compromised genome stability

constraints: TP53 +/- (heterozygous) does NOT protect from neoplasia
All gene mutations get penalty: mutation_instability_k added
Genomic instability factor increased: 1.2 instead of 1.0
TP53 still needs to mutate to -/- for actual neoplasia

decision_context.phase_purpose: Genome mutation phase - affected by instability

decisions.name: Should each gene mutate?
decisions.expected_outcome: HIGH probability of mutations (1.3% per gene)

expected_behavior: Cell is primed for neoplastic transformation in phase 4
If TP53 mutates to -/-, phase 4 neoplasia check will be critical

biological_significance.pre_condition: Cell had mutation in one TP53 allele
biological_significance.current_state: Accumulating additional mutations due to genomic instability
biological_significance.next_milestone: If TP53 mutates to -/-, cell can become neoplastic in phase 4
biological_significance.clinical_analogy: Li-Fraumeni syndrome: heterozygous TP53 individuals have very high cancer risk

next_phases_preview.phase4: Critical: If TP53 now -/-, neoplasia check will trigger. Otherwise remain normal but unstable.
next_phases_preview.phase5: Will emit signals if neoplastic, or remain silent if still normal
